name: hpsilab-quant-finance-mcp
description: 9-tool quant finance MCP server for stock analysis, options analytics, implied volatility radar, Monte Carlo stock simulation, AI prediction signals, pre-trade risk scanning, backtesting, research reports, and chart visualization.

tools.name: analyze_stock
tools.description: Use when you need one aggregated JSON snapshot of a stock's full quant profile — combines price data, IV radar, option pressure, Monte Carlo simulation, and AI prediction signals in a single call instead of calling each tool separately.

tools.name: get_iv_radar
tools.description: Use when you need to understand a stock's implied-volatility structure — how expensive its options are right now relative to history, and whether IV is elevated, depressed, or fairly priced.

tools.name: get_option_pressure
tools.description: Use when you need the option-chain pressure map for the nearest weekly or monthly expiry — Max Pain level, dealer positioning, and where large open-interest concentrations sit relative to the current price.

tools.name: get_monte_carlo
tools.description: Use when you need a probabilistic price forecast for a stock over roughly the next 10 trading days — runs thousands of randomized simulated paths and returns a distribution of likely outcomes rather than a single point estimate.

tools.name: get_pretrade_risk_scan
tools.description: Use when you need a full pre-trade risk check before entering a position on a stock — flags liquidity risk, volatility risk, and near-term event risk in a single structured JSON report.

tools.name: get_ai_prediction
tools.description: Use when you need a next-day directional signal for a stock — returns the model's probability that the stock closes up, plus a plain-language buy, watch, or sell read on current conditions.

tools.name: get_equity_curves
tools.description: Use when you need to see how the quant strategy would have performed historically across your watchlist — returns backtested equity curves along with Sharpe ratio and other risk-adjusted performance metrics.

tools.name: generate_stock_research_report
tools.description: Use when you need a complete, shareable research report for a stock — produces a full markdown writeup paired with five stock-report charts covering price, volatility, options, and prediction signals.

tools.name: generate_stock_images
tools.description: Use when you need standalone visual charts for a stock report rather than a full written report — generates the underlying stock-report PNG images and returns their URLs for embedding elsewhere.
